description: NM 2026 semi-final, Daniel Nygård vs Andreas Fjermestad (seven games, one broadcast video). Inputs for scripts/nm26-*.py.

g1.note: Start: timer tone at 21.6-25.0 s. 3-3 after regulation; Fjermestad's overtime goal at about 535 s (series 0-1 from 539 s). Nygård's goalie (white/blue) at the left end, so Nygård = team W in data/geometry.json terms.

g2.note: Nygård at the left end (white/blue figures). Window from the timer tones and the score overlay (docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

g3.note: Ends switched: Fjermestad at the left end with the white/blue figures, Nygård at the right with the yellow figures. Window from the timer tones and the score overlay (docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

g4.note: Ends switched as in g3. Window from the timer tones and the score overlay (docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

g5.note: Ends as in g1. Window from the timer tones and the score overlay (docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

g6.note: Ends switched as in g3. Window from the timer tones and the score overlay (docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

g7.note: Ends as in g1; the video ends about when the game does. Window from the timer tones and the score overlay (docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

figure_colours_by_end.note: The figures stay with the table: the left end (goal.W) always has the white/blue figures. Players switch ends 2-2-1-1-1, so a player's kit colour changes with the end (PiP camera and goalie colours, docs/nm26-game-patterns.md).

players_note: kit_in_g1: the figure colour each player used in game 1 (left end white/blue). Figures stay with the table ends (figure_colours_by_end), so in g3, g4 and g6 Nygård plays the yellow figures.
